import traceback
import warnings
import pandas as pd
from ydata_profiling import ProfileReport, compare

def mk(title, rng):
    return ProfileReport(pd.DataFrame({"a": rng}), title=title, progress_bar=False)

df1 = pd.DataFrame({"a": range(10)})
df2 = pd.DataFrame({"a": range(10, 20)})

print("=== TEST 2: report1.compare(report2) ===")
try:
    a = mk("R1", range(10)); b = mk("R2", range(10, 20))
    c = a.compare(b)
    h = c.to_html()
    print("type:", type(c).__name__, "html len:", len(h))
    print("RESULT_T2: PASS")
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc(); print("RESULT_T2: FAIL")

print()
print("=== TEST 3: compare two BaseDescription objects ===")
try:
    from ydata_profiling.model import BaseDescription
    a = mk("D1", range(10)); b = mk("D2", range(10, 20))
    d1 = a.get_description(); d2 = b.get_description()
    print("desc types:", type(d1).__name__, isinstance(d1, BaseDescription))
    c = compare([d1, d2])
    h = c.to_html()
    print("type:", type(c).__name__, "html len:", len(h))
    print("RESULT_T3: PASS")
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc(); print("RESULT_T3: FAIL")

print()
print("=== TEST 4: compare(compute=True) ===")
try:
    from ydata_profiling.config import Settings
    a = mk("C1", range(10)); b = mk("C2", range(10, 20))
    cfg = Settings()
    cfg.title = "Merged"
    c = compare([a, b], config=cfg, compute=True)
    h = c.to_html()
    print("type:", type(c).__name__, "html len:", len(h))
    print("RESULT_T4: PASS")
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc(); print("RESULT_T4: FAIL")

print()
print("=== TEST 4b: compare(compute=True) without config ===")
try:
    a = mk("E1", range(10)); b = mk("E2", range(10, 20))
    c = compare([a, b], compute=True)
    h = c.to_html()
    print("type:", type(c).__name__, "html len:", len(h))
    print("RESULT_T4b: PASS")
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc(); print("RESULT_T4b: FAIL")

print()
print("=== TEST 5: 3 reports -> warning ===")
try:
    a = mk("W1", range(10)); b = mk("W2", range(10, 20)); d = mk("W3", range(20, 30))
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        c = compare([a, b, d])
        msgs = [str(x.message) for x in w]
    print("warnings captured:", msgs)
    hit = [m for m in msgs if "more than two reports" in m]
    print("matched:", hit)
    h = c.to_html()
    print("html len:", len(h))
    print("RESULT_T5:", "PASS" if hit else "FAIL")
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc(); print("RESULT_T5: FAIL")

print()
print("=== TEST 6: 1 report -> ValueError ===")
try:
    a = mk("S1", range(10))
    compare([a])
    print("RESULT_T6: FAIL (no exception raised)")
except ValueError as e:
    print("ValueError:", e)
    print("RESULT_T6: PASS")
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc(); print("RESULT_T6: FAIL (wrong exception type)")

print()
print("=== TEST 6b: 0 reports -> ValueError ===")
try:
    compare([])
    print("RESULT_T6b: FAIL (no exception)")
except ValueError as e:
    print("ValueError:", e)
    print("RESULT_T6b: PASS")
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc(); print("RESULT_T6b: FAIL")
